naming._comment: 40 characters accommodates 25 of the 43 existing labels while staying well below the 61-character maximum; new labels can be shorter because mechanisms and purpose belong in metadata. Grandfathered names preserve existing build directories and historical logs; do not add new names to this list.

base.description: Use all registry defaults as the untuned configuration reference for build and solver checks.

best_decomp_mona.description: Use plain vector-backed downsets with decomposition, MONA precomputation, standard automaton preprocessing, critical input selection and no SIMD maximum comparisons as the downset comparison reference.

best_decomp_mona_any.description: Use Spot translation preference any instead of small to provide a shipped alternative translation with plain vector-backed downsets.

best_decomp_mona_diag.description: Compile phase diagnostics, enabled at runtime by ACACIA_DIAG, to profile the plain-vector downset reference.

best_decomp_rank_bucketed_mona.description: Replace plain vector-backed downsets with rank-bucketed vectors to compare rank-based dominance filtering in the downset sweep.

best_decomp_rank_bucketed_semantic_mona.description: Deduplicate equivalent MONA output actions before decoding to reduce action construction in the shipped backward solver with rank-bucketed downsets (B reference).

best_decomp_rank_bucketed_mona_eq_min_bl.description: Use the parent's unchanged two-block gate, three clients and 512-state cap as the lower-block arm against the four-block equivariant sweep control.

otf_sparse_formula.description: Retain backward and forward realizability and forward automaton-unreal solving, adding a sparse guarded formula-unreal worker. Include one bounded Spot obligation decision arm for eligible objectives.

otf_sparse_formula_gr1_prepass.description: Five-worker sparse guarded formula portfolio with one exact GR(1) worker using checked parameter pre-passes.

otf_sparse_formula_gr1_real_prepass.description: Six-arm sparse guarded formula portfolio with a checked realizability-only GR(1) pre-pass. Include one bounded Spot obligation decision arm for eligible objectives.

otf_forward.description: Compare Spot guarded and TAA arms using the best_decomp_rank_bucketed_semantic_mona_forward components and unchanged default arm selection.

otf_sparse_formula_parity.description: Seven-worker portfolio combining antichain search, sparse formula solving, a GR(1) realizability pre-pass, and exact Spot obligation and parity game solving.

ltlsynt_no_specials.description: ltlsynt with decomposition, bypass, and obligation synthesis disabled
